004.text: The skies above Gensokyo have been cleared.

006.name: Reimu
006.text: Agh, the Summer sun is back. It's so hot.

008.text: The mistress askes if you are feeling regretful.

010.name: Reimu
010.text: Oh, it's you two from the manor.

012.name: Sakuya
012.text: The mistress says we've come to crash at your shrine.

013.name: Reimu
013.text:
Shouldn't you be repelled by this place? I'd
			rather not have the shrine be crowded by youkai.

014.name: Sakuya
014.text:
It is a pretty decrepid building; perhaps you should put
			more work into repairing it?

015.name: Reimu
015.text:
Look, if I ever get married, the first thing I'm doing
			is making my man fix up this place.

016.name: Sakuya
016.text:
But speaking of damages, are you aware that you caused quite
			a bit of collateral damage all over my house?

017.name: Sakuya
017.text: The gatekeeper is quite mad that you stepped all over her garden.

018.name: Reimu
018.text: Irk. I don't have any way to pay.

019.name: Sakuya
019.text: Yeah we can tell. But the mistress can let bygones be bygones.

020.name: Sakuya
020.text: Just a teensy favor to ask you.

023.name: Sakuya
023.text: The mistress would like you to clear out her basement.

024.name: Reimu
024.text:
Like clearing out dustbunnies or something?
			Isn't that your job?

026.name: Sakuya
026.text:
The mistress needs someone as strong as her to do it,
			and you have already proven yourself.

027.name: Reimu
027.text:
What kind of dustbunnies are we taliking about?!
			You make it sound like extermination work!

029.name: Sakuya
029.text:
The mistress says no extermination.
			Just clean it out. Please stop by tomorrow.

030.name: Reimu
030.text: Looks like I don't really have a choice.

032.text:
Congratulations!
			Start the Extra Stage to continue the story.
